references.summary: Passwords use bcrypt with bounded blocking work and an unknown-user dummy hash. Minimum 8 characters, maximum 72 bytes. No native password change, recovery, breached-password check, TOTP, passkey or SAML route was found. This means Unicode password length and the ASVS 64-character requirement need particular care.
